items.title: Von der Leyen proposes €45bn loan to Ukraine backed by joint debt
items.summary: Brussels will go back to the markets to raise an additional €45 billion to keep Ukraine in the fight against Russia. Soaring borrowing costs are set to make the new credit costly and politically difficult.

items.title: EU proposes new €45 billion Ukraine loan to be repaid by Russia
items.summary: European Commission President Ursula von ⁠der Leyen announced on Wednesday a proposed €45 billion loan to Ukraine for 2027 to help cover around two-thirds ​of Kyiv's financing ​needs. The loan will be repaid ⁠through future ⁠war reparations by Russia, von der Leyen added.

items.title: 'Human': Cambridge Dictionary's Word of the Year 2026 tackles ongoing AI fears
items.summary: Amid the global and controversial debate surrounding artificial intelligence in daily life, Cambridge Dictionary has crowned “human” as its Word of the Year for 2026.

items.title: Bahrain sentences Shia clerics to life over alleged Iran plot amid torture allegations
items.summary: Bahrain has arrested dozens of Shia clerics since the Iran war began in late February. Authorities accuse them of plotting with Tehran, while rights groups have raised concerns about torture and forced confessions. Gulf states have backed Bahrain’s judiciary.

items.title: Nasa’s Voyager 1 just reached a massive milestone in space - video
items.summary: Nasa sent the Voyager 1 and 2 probes into space almost 50 years ago to explore the outer reaches of our solar system. Now Voyager 1, the farthest human-made object from Earth, is about to reach a distance of one light-day away from our planet. items.title: Why has an NYT report on Iran’s dams ignited fierce pushback?
items.summary: The NYT faces backlash over report suggesting a possible link between Iranian dams and underground missile facilities.

items.title: Traumas of Sudan war lead to wave of drug addiction
items.summary: Anguish caused by conflict sees a growing number of young people turn to drugs.

items.title: Emma Barnett pays tribute to 'decent journalism' in final Today episode
items.summary: Radio presenter Emma Barnett has paid tribute to "decent journalism" in her final moments hosting the Today programme.

items.title: Nvidia posts blockbuster quarterly results amid leadership crisis
items.summary: AI chipmaker Nvidia posted Q3 revenues double those of last year and 20 percent higher than last quarter, while the company board says it has no intention of reinstating disgraced former CEO Jensen Huang. Also in this edition: gaming tourists flock to Miami amid a marketing blitz for the upcoming release of the latest edition in the "Grand Theft Auto" franchise.

items.title: Ukraine bets on flying evacuation drones to get wounded soldiers out of 'kill zone'
items.summary: The Stargate drone can travel at 105 kilometres per hour, carry loads of up to 150 kilograms with a range of 30 kilometres. Each one costs about €45,000.

items.title: Trump lands in China with key meetings with Xi and Putin on the agenda
items.summary: Xi paid Trump a special honor by greeting him on the tarmac after Air Force One arrived in Shenzhen, reciprocating a gesture made by the U.S. president during Xi's visit to Washington in September.

items.title: Early alerts, simple journeys and a stress-free experience: What passengers want at airports
items.summary: ACI World’s 2027 global traveller survey found that while 77% of passengers leave airports with ‘positive emotions’, they are seeking seamless journeys and want to be kept in the loop about potential disruptions.

items.title: Democrats win Alaska Senate race two weeks after midterms counting began
items.summary: Confirmation of Mary Peltola's victory caps of the party's rout of the Republicans in the midterms Senate election.
